title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta14

## Canonical dock-position authority

This beta fixes the remaining mower-marker jump reported in #437 after the
phantom straight trail itself was fixed in beta10.

The trail and position issues are separate. The current-cycle polygon guard
continues to prevent invalid retained trail edges, while beta14 changes only the
Canonical PositionResolver that owns the public mower XY position.

### Confirmed Dock now beats private-cloud last posture

The private `get-location` endpoint can return a newly fetched response whose
`posture_x` / `posture_y` still describe an older mower location. During Home
Assistant startup or reconnect this could briefly win before the first fresh
official MQTT pose arrived, making a docked mower appear elsewhere on the lawn
for a few seconds.

PositionResolver now uses this precedence:

1. fresh official MQTT pose;
2. confirmed `docked` state + map charging-station XY, when no local departure
   command is pending;
3. private-cloud position;
4. unavailable.

A pending mow/pause/return transition suppresses the station override so an old
Dock state cannot pin a mower to the charging station while it is being
dispatched. If station geometry is unavailable, private-cloud fallback remains
unchanged.

This is implemented directly in Canonical PositionResolver. No Map Card wrapper
or additional runtime patch layer is added.

### Cloud pose freshness uses vendor report time

Canonical private-cloud position age is no longer derived from the time when
Home Assistant most recently fetched `get-location`. That timestamp only proves
that the HTTP response is new, not that the posture inside it is new.

Beta14 instead uses the vendor `location.report_time` value (with the existing
private-cloud pose-time fallback). Diagnostics now expose the resulting
`cloud_position_age_s`, and a Dock station override is reported as
`docked_station_authority` / `map_station` without exposing exact coordinates.

Fresh MQTT remains the highest-priority source in all states.

No Map Card update is required. Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta7 remains the
matching frontend.
